main.summary: Coordinates stream transfer session operations backed by PostgreSQL state and Azure Blob payloads.

field.name: sessions
field.summary: Transfer-session state and payload store used by the stream service.

field.name: registry
field.summary: Registry used to track active transfer sessions.

field.name: coordinator
field.summary: Coordinator used to acquire transfer item, session, and mutation scopes.

field.name: publications
field.summary: Publication-transfer store used to manage publication journals.

field.name: storageContext
field.summary: Request-scoped authorized storage context that supplies the catalog binding.

field.name: grainFactory
field.summary: Orleans client factory used to read catalog-owned item identity and deletion state.

constructor.name: DataControlStreamTransferService
constructor.param: Orleans client factory used to read catalog-owned item state.

method.name: LoadRequiredManifest
method.summary: Loads and validates the manifest identity and current catalog-owned item instance token for a stream transfer session.

method.name: TouchSessionActivity
method.summary: Renews the server-observed activity time for a successfully read, queried, or reopened stream transfer session.
method.exception: The transfer session no longer exists.

method.name: CreateOpenManifest
method.summary: Creates the initial stream-source manifest bound to the active catalog item token or a fresh candidate token.
method.param: Item instance token assigned to the upload.

method.name: CreateFollowerManifest
method.summary: Creates a follower manifest bound to the same item instance token as its existing stream source manifest.

method.name: SynchronizeFollowerManifest
method.summary: Synchronizes follower state and payload metadata from its source manifest without changing the item instance token inherited when the follower was opened.

method.name: ReadRequiredCompletionStreamHash
method.summary: Reads and hashes the complete realized stream payload.
method.returns: The SHA-512 hash of the completed stream.

method.name: ToServerSessionInfo
method.summary: Converts a stream manifest into the server session information shape.

method.name: CreateRange
method.summary: Creates a transfer range from an offset and length.

method.name: ClampPolicy
method.summary: Clamps a requested segment-size policy to the service default policy.

method.name: ValidateIdentity
method.summary: Validates a transfer identity.

method.name: ValidateManifestIdentity
method.summary: Validates that a manifest belongs to the expected session and item and carries a non-empty item instance token.

method.name: ValidateMutationScope
method.summary: Validates that a mutation scope belongs to the expected session and item.

method.name: ValidateAbortRequest
method.summary: Validates an abort request.

method.name: ValidateRemoveRequest
method.summary: Validates that a remove request contains non-empty session and item identifiers.

method.name: ValidateOpenFollowRequest
method.summary: Validates an open-follower request.

method.name: ValidateReOpenFollowRequest
method.summary: Validates a reopen-follower request.

method.name: ValidateReOpenRequest
method.summary: Validates a reopen-source request.

method.name: ValidateReadRequest
method.summary: Validates a stream segment-read request.

method.name: ValidateWriteRequest
method.summary: Validates a stream segment-write request and payload.

method.name: ValidateCompleteRequest
method.summary: Validates a stream completion request.

method.name: ValidOptionalHash
method.summary: Determines whether an optional SHA-512 hash has an accepted length.
method.returns: True when the hash is absent, empty, or a SHA-512 hash.

method.name: ValidateReadable
method.summary: Validates that a stream manifest permits read operations.

method.name: ValidateAbortableSession
method.summary: Validates that a stream upload session is open or complete and can be aborted.

method.name: ValidateWritableSource
method.summary: Validates that a stream manifest permits source writes.

method.name: ValidateSegmentLength
method.summary: Validates a segment length against the effective session policy.

method.name: ValidateHash
method.summary: Validates two SHA-512 hash values.

method.name: ValidateOpenRequest
method.summary: Validates an open-source request and its object payload.
